editions.briefing: The US and Iran traded strikes across the Gulf, with drones reported near bases in Kuwait and Bahrain. Mary Peltola won Alaska's Senate race, and Xi greeted Trump at the APEC summit. OpenAI released GPT-6.2, and Anthropic's IPO is reportedly set to price this week. HHS finalized a HIPAA records rule, and the US lost measles elimination status. In Idaho, a Fish and Game commissioner will plead guilty in a poaching case.
